name: Energy Center Camp (Ages 4-6)
description_short: A day camp at the Weymouth Club for children ages 4 to 6, running 9:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. Activities include tennis, free swim, games, arts and crafts and gym time, with a theme each week.
refund_policy_summary: No refunds or transfers once the club accepts a registration, for any reason (withdrawal, dismissal, missed days). Payment is due in full when you register.
swim_waterfront_notes: The daily schedule includes free swim. Children should wear a bathing suit to camp every day and bring a towel. Swim supervision and swim testing are not described.

Summer weekly prices depend on membership: $425/week for members and $525/week for non-members. The non-member rate is used for price_per_week.
Summer registration is by full week only, with a 2-week minimum. The page does not list summer week dates, so only the two spring vacation sessions are recorded. Their prices are not stated.
The registration link on the page leads to the Dance parent portal, so it was not recorded as the camp registration URL.

After-camp care (2:00-3:00 p.m.) runs only if 3 or more campers sign up for that day. Early drop-off and after-camp care each cost $15/hour for members and $25/hour for non-members. Late pickup after 3:00 p.m. costs $1 per minute.
